description: This PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_ConfigSchema' constructs and returns a runtime configuration schema object from an interchange schema, processing directives and their properties.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_ConfigSchema
classes.description: A builder class that converts an interchange schema into a runtime configuration schema object used for validation and processing.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an 'HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema' object from a given interchange schema by processing directives, adding allowed values, aliases, and value aliases, then finalizes with post-processing.
